text:
Maya: Quick ping — onboarding PR #4823 failing the config lint. Weights URI in config.json points to gs://redwood-models/mosaic3b/v2/weights.tar.gz but CI can't fetch it. Also tokenizer mapping looks like it has two <bos> ids? Can someone eyeball?

James: I saw that lint job. CI error says 404 from GCS auth when trying to download weights. PR added a signed URL step but maybe wrong bucket policy.

CI-bot: ci/lint-config — failed

CI-bot: Error: failed to fetch asset gs://redwood-models/mosaic3b/v2/weights.tar.gz -> 404

Alex: @Sam can you check bucket perms? If the service account used by the CI has role/storage.objectViewer on redwood-models

Sam: looking. quick check: CI SA has objectViewer on redwood-models-staging but not on redwood-models (prod). PR defaulted to prod path. Will add an allow-list entry for CI SA in staging to unblock e2e.

Olga: tokenizer quirk: the tokenizer.json in the asset bundle sets "bos_token_id": 1 and also includes a special token mapping that maps "<s>" -> 1 and "<bos>" -> 1; the config validator flags duplicate special tokens. We should normalize to single canonical name (we use "<s>" for byte-level models here).

Maya: noted. For immediate unblock can we change config.json to point to gs://redwood-models-staging/mosaic3b/v2/weights.tar.gz and update tokenizer.json to remove <bos> alias. I can push quick fix if infra agrees.

James: also lint rule: config.schema requires either "bos_token_id" or "special_tokens.mapping" but not both conflicting. Our validator currently treats duplicate ids as warning, not error — we should escalate to error for onboarding flows.

Alex: agree. Filing a tiny change to config-validator: treat duplicate special token ids as error when onboarding=true. I'll open PR.

Sam: I gave CI SA objectViewer on redwood-models-staging. CI should retry in ~5m. No change in prod.

CI-bot: ci/lint-config — retry queued

CI-bot: ci/lint-config — passed

Maya: thanks all. I'll push the staging path + tokenizer alias removal in PR #4823 and cc @Alex on validator PR. Follow-up: create an infra ticket to document SA permissions for onboarding buckets.

Olga: also leaving a note: when onboarding diff contains both tokenizer and config.json we should run a small sanity script that checks for duplicate special token ids across files. I'll add to the onboarding checklist.

Maya: perfect — moving to done for this thread. :thumbsup:
